company.description:
Most goal apps feel like homework. Lioma feels like talking to someone who actually gets it.

THREE COACHES, ONE GRAND HOTEL

Lioma is a coaching grand hotel with three AI coaches. Each has their own voice, their own purpose, and their own way of telling you what you need to hear.

Eve, the Concierge, starts your morning. She cuts through your ambitious chaos and helps you choose one goal that actually matters. Not seven. One. Revolutionary strategy. Nobel Prize pending.

Charlie, the Barista, ends your evening. He asks how it really went. Not the highlight reel. The real story. He has heard four thousand "I will do it tomorrow" stories. Yours is not special. But you are. That is why he pushes.

Clara, the Pianist, goes deeper. Unlock her after completing your first three goals. She handles the quarterly vision work, the hard questions about direction, the conversations about whether these goals are even yours anymore.

Together, they do what world-class coaches do: daily check-ins, pattern recognition, quarterly vision setting. The kind of coaching usually reserved for corner offices. Now in your pocket.

COACHING, NOT JUST TRACKING

Lioma understands context, asks thoughtful questions, and helps you navigate the messy reality of changing your life.

The coaches challenge you:

"You skipped writing three times this week. What is making it hard to start?"

"You keep saying 'I should.' Who told you that? Do you actually want this?"

"You hit your target but seem flat. What were you really hoping would change?"

THE METHOD

Great coaches use a three-layer approach:

Daily Check-ins: Eve helps you set intentions. Charlie helps you process what happened. The plan meets reality. Reality usually wins. But you adapt.

Patterns: Step back from the weeds. Your diary reveals themes you missed while you were busy being overwhelmed.

Quarterly Vision: Every quarter, Clara guides you through examining your larger direction. Bring coffee. Or something stronger.
